title_sq: Prane Rrethrrotullimit Te Shkozes, Shitet Shtepi 2 Kateshe Ideale Per Banim!!!
description_sq: Prane Rrethrrotullimit Te Shkozes, Shitet Shtepi 2 Kateshe Ideale Per Banim!!! Prona ka nje siperfaqe banimi 180.6 m2 dhe siperfaqe trualli 184.8 m2. Kati i pare ka siperfaqe 77.3 m2 dhe organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes, 1 dhome gjumi dhe tualeti. Kati i dyte ka siperfaqe 103.3 m2 dhe organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes, 2 dhoma gjumi, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Prona ka cilesi te mire ndertimi dhe themele me pilota per tu ngritur dhe 2 kate te tjera. Prona eshte e pajisur me dokumentacion te plote hipotekor. Oborri ofron hapesire dhe mundesi parkimi per nje automjet. Cmimi i shitjes se prones eshte 37.000.000 Leke te reja. Zona aty prane ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: Near the Shkoza roundabout, 2-storey house for sale, ideal for living!!!
description_en: Near the Shkoza roundabout, 2-storey house for sale, ideal for living!!! The property has a living area of ​​180.6 m2 and a land area of ​​184.8 m2. The first floor has a surface of 77.3 m2 and is organized by the living room, 1 bedroom and a toilet. The second floor has an area of ​​103.3 m2 and is organized by the living room, 2 bedrooms, toilet and balcony. The property has good construction quality and foundations with piles to be raised and 2 more floors. The property is equipped with full mortgage documentation. The yard offers space and parking for one vehicle. The sale price of the property is 37,000,000 new Lek. The nearby area offers all the facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
